scientific_integrity: The novelty claim is limited to an exact strict phase-boundary sensitivity and a verified nondegenerate universal leading peak-fusion law.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional symmetric Poisson telegraph force with additive independent Gaussian diffusion; fixed 0<q<1 at critical fusion; no independent validation or uniqueness priority proof. The phase boundary and its endpoint logarithmic asymptotic are already known and excluded from novelty.
title: Strict sensitivity and universal peak fusion at the noisy telegraph-trap transition
